blind_answer.reason: Microservice restructuring is a large, multi-file change with architectural implications. Plan mode lets Claude Code explore the codebase and propose a service design for review before any file is edited, so conflicts with the deployment infrastructure surface early. The other options keep direct execution, so none of them prevents the costly rework.
